{#l538} # Discussion

{#xkyy} ⟨待采纳·删除·张教授⟩ In the present analysis, we explored the optimal treatment for LS-SCLC with bulky tumor. Our results demonstrated that compared to sequential TRT combined with cisplatin and intravenous etoposide, concurrent TRT combined with cisplatin and oral etoposide yielded more favorable PFS and OS with acceptable treatment-related toxicity among patients who had completed 3-4 cycles of induction chemotherapy and achieved a remission. Results from multivariate analysis also confirmed the benefit of concurrent chemoradiotherapy after induction chemotherapy in PFS and OS. Our results provided a more efficient treatment strategy for LS-SCLC with bulky tumor.

{#hsby} # Introduction

{#a2k5} The concurrent thoracic radiotherapy (TRT) combined with chemotherapy has been proved to improve overall survival (OS) and considered to be the standard treatment for limited-stage small-cell lung cancer (LS-SCLC) [1–3]. In the regimen of platinum chemotherapy concurrent with TRT, a significant higher 5-year survival was observed when chest radiotherapy was started within 30 days after the start of chemotherapy [4–7]. Other studies failed to show a survival advantage of early TRT with chemotherapy for LS-SCLC [8, 9]. In a Korean study of LS-SCLC, TRT starting in the third cycle of chemotherapy was not inferior to early TRT and had a more favorable profile with regard to neutropenic fever . However, patients with LS-SCLC always had bulky tumors that would require large radiation target volume with concomitant increase in acute or chronic toxicity. Chemoradiotherapy might be interrupted because of intolerance in most patients, thus therapeutic effect was affected. Compared with sequential late radiation therapy, early radiation therapy with poor implementation of chemotherapy did not improve the survival [10]. Therefore, 3-4 cycles of induction chemotherapy before TRT for LS-SCLC with bulky tumor was often performed in clinic, which also made up time for preparing TRT.

{#l538} # Discussion

{#xkyy} ⟨待采纳·删除·张教授⟩ In the present analysis, we explored the optimal treatment for LS-SCLC with bulky tumor. Our results demonstrated that compared to sequential TRT combined with cisplatin and intravenous etoposide, concurrent TRT combined with cisplatin and oral etoposide yielded more favorable PFS and OS with acceptable treatment-related toxicity among patients who had completed 3-4 cycles of induction chemotherapy and achieved a remission. Results from multivariate analysis also confirmed the benefit of concurrent chemoradiotherapy after induction chemotherapy in PFS and OS. Our results provided a more efficient treatment strategy for LS-SCLC with bulky tumor.

{#szye} ⟨待采纳·新增·张教授⟩ In the present analysis, we explored the optimal treatment for LS-SCLC with bulky tumor. Our results suggested that compared to sequential TRT combined with cisplatin and intravenous etoposide, concurrent TRT combined with cisplatin and oral etoposide yielded more favorable PFS and OS with acceptable treatment-related toxicity among patients who had completed 3-4 cycles of induction chemotherapy and achieved a remission. Results from multivariate analysis also confirmed the benefit of concurrent chemoradiotherapy after induction chemotherapy in PFS and OS. Our results provided a more efficient treatment strategy for LS-SCLC with bulky tumor.

ops.markdown: Previous studies have suggested that early delivery of thoracic radiotherapy (TRT) is associated with long-term survival [5, 6, 10, 12–14]. A meta-analysis, however, indicated that this benefit was confined to patients who were able to complete full doses of chemotherapy [8]. One plausible explanation for the advantage of early TRT is that it may eradicate chemotherapy-resistant tumor cells, which are prone to systemic dissemination and treatment failure [6]. Nevertheless, several limitations of early TRT deserve consideration. First, because the planning and preparation for radiotherapy are complex, initiating TRT during the first cycle of chemotherapy may in practice be delayed, thereby prolonging the overall treatment time. Second, in contrast to previous study populations, all patients in the present analysis had a large tumor burden that required large radiation target volumes; induction chemotherapy produced tumor shrinkage and substantially reduced the radiation planning volumes, thereby decreasing toxicity to normal tissue [15, 16]. Given that this study enrolled LS-SCLC patients with a large tumor burden, induction chemotherapy was therefore delivered before TRT. Notably, the meta-analysis of seven randomised trials by Pijls-Johannesma et al. showed no significant difference in 2- or 5-year survival between early and late chest radiotherapy in the overall analysis, whereas in trials using platinum-based chemotherapy concurrent with TRT, starting TRT within 30 days after the start of chemotherapy significantly improved 2-year survival (HR 0.73, 95% CI 0.57–0.94, p=0.01) and 5-year survival (HR 0.65, 95% CI 0.45–0.93, p=0.02), a benefit that was even more pronounced when the overall treatment time of TRT was less than 30 days [@c:c388abde].

已经改好了，就在 Discussion 第二节前的“Previous studies suggested that early delivery of TRT…”这一段（也就是张教授修订中标记为“新增”的那一版）。这段润色主要是让句子更通顺，并把论证链条理顺：

**主要改动**

1. **修正了明显的病句**：原句 “tumor cells which always devoted to disseminate systemically and treatment failure” 语法不通，改为 “chemotherapy-resistant tumor cells, which are prone to systemic dissemination and treatment failure”。
2. **明确指代关系**：把 “But a meta-analysis indicated that only patients who completed full doses…” 改成 “A meta-analysis, however, indicated that **this benefit** was confined to patients who were able to complete full doses of chemotherapy”，读者一眼就知道“这个获益”指前面的早期放疗获益。
3. **语气更肯定但保持克制**：开头 “seemed to be related to” 改为 “is associated with”；“some limitations…should be taken into consideration” 改为 “several limitations…deserve consideration”。
4. **论点结构更清楚**：把 “On one hand… On the other hand…” 改成 “First… Second…”，第二点用分号把“大肿瘤负荷需大靶区 → 诱导化疗缩瘤、缩小计划靶区、降低正常组织毒性”串成一条因果链，并补上 “in contrast to previous study populations”，使对照更显性。
5. **用词更准确**：“Contributed to tumor shrinkage and significant reduction of radiation planning” 改为 “produced tumor shrinkage and substantially reduced the radiation planning volumes”。
6. **转承更自然**：衔接元分析那句的 “By comparison,” 改为 “Notably,”，避免与上一句的比较关系含混；并在首次出现处写全 “thoracic radiotherapy (TRT)”。

**没有动的地方**：所有方括号文献编号（[5, 6, 10, 12–14]、[8]、[6]、[15, 16]）、元分析的引文锚点，以及 HR、95% CI、P 值等数字全部原样保留。

- 这一段目前仍处在张教授修订的“待采纳”状态（旧版标记为删除、新版标记为新增），我的润色做在“新增”那一版上，你在审阅里采纳这条修订即可看到最终文本。
